text:
maria: Customer AcmeFin (O-2377) opened a ticket — SSO failing for a subset of users after IdP maintenance. Error shows 'Assertion has expired' on our side: `SAML::InvalidConditions - NotOnOrAfter`. Anyone seen this pattern recently? cc @alex

alex: I have. Usually clock skew or the IdP issued an assertion with very tight validity window. Can you paste the raw SAML assertion or a decoded snippet? Also send the exact SP entityID they hit.

maria: Pasting obfuscated assertion we got from their support rep. They base64'd it in the browser console.

maria: ```
echo "PHNhbWxwOkFzc2VydGlvbiB4bWxucz0naHR0cDovL3NhbWxwJy4uLg==" | base64 -d | xmllint --format -
```

maria: Decoded portion (redacted):
```xml
<saml:Conditions NotBefore="2026-03-15T13:20:00Z" NotOnOrAfter="2026-03-15T13:22:00Z">
  <saml:AudienceRestriction>
    <saml:Audience>https://api.redwood.com/saml/sp/AcmeFin</saml:Audience>
  </saml:AudienceRestriction>
</saml:Conditions>
```

maria: Our login attempt happened at ~2026-03-15T13:25:10Z per logs, so the assertion is already expired by ~3m. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T13:25:10.321Z] SAML.validateAssertion: InvalidConditions - ActualTime 2026-03-15T13:25:10Z NotOnOrAfter 2026-03-15T13:22:00Z
[2026-03-15T13:25:10.322Z] SSO.loginFail: assertion_expired AcmeFin user=j.smith
```

sam: If it's only a subset of users, could be network delays or the IdP issuing short-lived assertions for certain apps. Also check their proxy/time filters.

indra: Quick checks for AcmeFin admin: ask them to verify NTP on their IdP hosts. If they're using Okta, check System Logs -> Sign On -> SAML Response timestamps. In Okta you can see the exact NotOnOrAfter.

alex: Two mitigation options:
1) Have IdP increase assertion lifetime (NotOnOrAfter) to at least 5m for the SP, or
2) We relax clock-tolerance on our SAML connector for this tenant to accept small skew (we currently default to strict 0s). We have a per-connector setting `AllowClockSkewSeconds`.

jen: Are there security concerns with increasing clock skew?

alex: Small allowance (60-120s) is common and safe; it prevents transient failures from tiny clock differences or network latency. We should avoid >5m without product approval. Also note: if the IdP time is grossly out-of-sync (hours), that's a real security issue.

lucas: For triage steps I recommend:
- Reproduce with a debug user from their org and capture full SAML response.
- Decode assertion and compare NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter to our service time.
- If difference <= 120s, apply temporary `AllowClockSkewSeconds=120` in canary for their connector.
- Ask IdP admin to confirm NTP and check for recent maintenance that might've reset clock.

maria: Tried repro with a test account — observed same 3m expiry. I asked AcmeFin to run `date -u` on their IdP host and share output. Waiting on that.

sso-bot: ConnectorConfigChange queued for tenant AcmeFin. Change: `AllowClockSkewSeconds=120` (canary: 5% of auth traffic) — initiated by maria.

maria: Applied the canary. Will monitor.

[~10m later]

maria: Can confirm affected users can sign in now after the canary was applied. No new assertion_expired logs for those sessions. :white_check_mark:

indra: Please still ask them to fix the root cause (NTP) and ideally increase default assertion lifetime on their SAML app to 5m. Also request they regenerate metadata if they did any cert/key rotations during maintenance.

alex: I'll create a short KB entry for Support with quick triage steps (decode assertion, check NotOnOrAfter, apply small clock skew) and a sample command: 
```bash
echo "$SAML_BASE64" | base64 -d | xmllint --format - | sed -n '1,120p'
```

jen: Can we add monitoring alert that fires when we see >5 assertion_expired errors from a single tenant in 10m? That's an easy postmortem signal.

lucas: Good idea. I'll add a per-tenant alert in the console (rate threshold) and a Grafana panel for SAML failures by reason.

maria: Summary / action items:
- Applied `AllowClockSkewSeconds=120` canary for AcmeFin (maria) — mitigated sign-in failures.
- Ask AcmeFin to verify NTP and check IdP logs for recent maintenance (maria -> sent).
- Alex to write KB triage doc and include decode snippet + recommended thresholds.
- Lucas to add alert for mass assertion_expired errors.
- Follow up in 24h to revert clock-skew relax if they fix IdP.

maria: tagging ticket O-2377 as "mitigated - waiting on customer remediation" and closing thread here. Thanks everyone.
